item.title: Building Your Own Voice Drama Library with Kikoto
item.description: As your collection of voice dramas grows, your folders get longer and longer. Sometimes you can only remember the cover image or the voice actor, but not the title; other times, you stopped listening halfway through last night and have to drag the progress bar around the next day just to find your spot. Even though the files are on your own hard drive, finding them and picking up where you left off can still take extra effort. Kikoto is an open-source voice drama library I …
